t: You're on Broadway Market, a street in Hackney best known for the street market held here. Licences to trade are issued by a committee of councillors from Hackney Council, so the stalls you see are there by their approval. One person connected to the street is Edward Betts, a Wikimedian and Debian developer, who lived here. That's all I can say about him, but it's a nice reminder that this is a place where people live as well as shop.
